To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

comment.narrative: Third National Communication (TNC) submitted to the UNFCCC in 2016. Second Biennial Update Report (2BUR) submitted to UNFCCC in 2017.

- Lebanons 4th NC, including part of outputs of consultancies on inventory, mitigation and adaptation (water and agriculture) are initiated - Consultation meetings on Technology Needs assessment are conducted - Consultancies on inventory and mitigation options for transport, energy waste sectors are launched; - Consultancy on adaptation for water and agriculture is launched; - National experts are trained on LEAP and MISCA and FORFITS - MISCA is updated as per the new IPCC guidelines - Information sharing system with MoA on fertilizers will be designed - Infographics will be designed and printed

- Lebanons Fourth National Communication finalized and submitted to the UNFCCC - Study on vulnerability of health care facilities finalized - Study on transport patterns for 2021 finalized - Study on technology needs assessment for agriculture and water finalized - Review of vulnerability assessment finalized - 4NC designed and printed - Dissemination and capacity building sessions organized

- Lebanon Fourth National Communication submitted to the UNFCCC in December 2022 - Study on vulnerability of health care facilities published - Study on transport patterns for 2019-2022 finalized - Study on technology needs assessment for agriculture and water finalised and included in 4NC - Review of climate risk and vulnerability assessment finalized and incuded in 4NC - Consultation sessions organized for agriculture and water sectors (June 13, 2022) as well as private sector ( May 9 and August 3, 2022) - Carbon footrpint event for private sector organized on September 7, 2022 - Proposal for CBIT finalized and project approved - Proposal for GCF NAP finalized and submitted - Proposal for BTR1-5NC/BTR2 initated - 4 concept notes for Arab Finance Forum ESCWA prepared and submitted - Social media posts related to climate change prepared and published

-GHG inventory for the year 2018 finalized - Lebanons BUR4 finalized and submitted to the UNFCCC in december 2021 - Vulnerability and Climate change impacts chapter drafted, recruitment of a national expert for chapter review drafted initiated - Technology Needs Assessment chapter finalized for the energy and transport sectors - Awareness and dissemination activities undertaken, including participation in 15 webinars /panel discussions - Capacity built for 18 national experts, including staff from the Ministry of Environment, related to GHG inventory, uncertainty assessment, Enhanced Transparency Framework and NAP preparations
